summary: Unit tests cover core matrix-generator logic well (cartesian product, include/exclude, fail-fast, max-parallel, size limits), but catastrophically fail the primary requirement: the task mandates 'ALL TESTS MUST RUN THROUGH ACT' via GitHub Actions workflow integration, with fixture data, act-result.txt artifact generation, and workflow structure validation. The provided tests are local-only (`bun test`). Missing: .github/workflows/environment-matrix-generator.yml file, act-based test harness, integration tests validating real workflow execution, workflow structure tests (YAML parsing, actionlint), and the required act-result.txt output. The existing 14 test cases are well-organized with good cleanup but lack edge cases (empty arrays, deduplication, special chars, ordering), boundary conditions (very large matrices), and documentation of TDD approach. This is a CI/CD-first task with the entire CI/CD validation layer absent from the test suite.
